answer: At the granite inlet, an agent stakes 38.6 POA and presents a pearl grown 14 days in a tagged cage, with daily mass logged to 0.02 g, to receive one berth chit. The chit clears only when a dockside crystal fork at 2.17 kHz returns a 7-beat envelope hashing to the cage ID. Inspectors reweigh the pearl and replay the fork; a 0.05 g drift or a second chit from the same cage voids both claims and burns 58% of the stake. A 600-clone wave needs 600 live cages and 23,160 POA; a fork miss above 12 cents or a cage reused inside 9 epochs freezes that berth for 15 epochs.
